_comment: WHERE EACH DESK SITS ON THE REGIONAL ATLAS — geography and placement only.
Nothing editorial lives here. Name, route, status, counts and scope come
from desks/registry.json and the database, exactly as on every other
surface. Every public registry desk has an entry (tests/test_desk_map.py).
seat     where the desk's publishing institutions are based; the point is
that place, never an area of coverage.
anchor   [lon, lat] of the seat, east-positive. It must fall on land in
site/assets/geo/atlas-50m.json.
short    the name beside the point on the Desks atlas.
label    which side of the point the name sits: left, right or below;
label_narrow, if given, replaces it when the atlas is narrow.
locator_at  optional [x, y] fractions: where the seat sits in the desk
page's locator window, when the default would show mostly land.
outside  instead of seat/anchor: the desk's institutions are outside the
atlas frame. The atlas shows an edge pointer naming this place,
and the desk page has no locator. (The US Indo-Pacific Reference
Desk's registered sources are the USCC and the Treasury; nothing
from U.S. Pacific Command, in Hawaii, is configured, so the former
Hawaii seat is no longer drawn. 2026-11-17.)
Drawing: scripts/build_atlas.py. Indonesia is placed at Jakarta, the
seat of its declared institution (2026-11-17).
